sloka: इत्येवं संवदन् वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।तस्मादवातरच्छीव्रं पर्वताग्रान्महाबलः ।। ६.४१.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: ityevaṁ saṁvadan vīro lakṣmaṇaṁ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ।tasmādavātaracchīvraṁ parvatāgrānmahābalaḥ ।। 6.41.22 ।।।।

translations.english: "The land will remain covered by rocks, tridents, swords hurled by the Vanaras and Rakshasas and with flesh and blood."
